mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country company registry, ministry of trade, or tax authority; Egyptian consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney appointing the Egyptian incorporation agent and its named individual counsel
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the shareholder's home jurisdiction and notarized for signature capacity of the authorized corporate officer

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport issuing authority in each UBO's home country; photocopy certified by notary public; Egyptian consular legalization

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Compulsory before incorporation and on a continuing basis for every shareholder, UBO, director, manager, authorized signatory and PEP-related family member/close associate: (1) screening against the UN Security Council consolidated list and locally designated terrorist lists; (2) OFAC SDN screening for USD/fuel-card/SWIFT payments; (3) UK-HMT and EU consolidated lists to the extent the trucking route or payment chain touches UK/EU; (4) Egypt's Central Bank of Egypt and Ministry of Justice terrorism financing lists; (5) domestic PEP search in Egyptian public offices and GAFI declarations. Enhanced due diligence must include negative news, source-of-funds explanation, organizational chart and 25% UBO threshold identification, with a written AML file maintained for statutory retention periods.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: GAFI Single Window electronic incorporation portal (General Authority for Investment and Free Zones) linked with the Commercial Registry operating under the Ministry of Trade and Industry
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The legal company name must be in Arabic and must be transliterated into Latin characters only as a secondary filing; the Arabic name is authoritative. The name must include the LLC designation, must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered name, and must not imply a company form different from a Limited Liability Company.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The reservation is valid for 30 days and is automatically released if the incorporation is not completed within that window; no extension is available. Upon rejection, GAFI issues an electronic refusal stating the conflicting name or prohibited token. The applicant or its Egyptian counsel may submit a written administrative objection to GAFI within 15 days of the refusal, annexing the reservation receipt, proposed Arabic/Latin names and justification. If the objection is denied, judicial review may be filed before the Administrative Court through the Council of State under the Egyptian Administrative Procedure Law. A fresh name reservation may be filed immediately with a different proposed name.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible for this regulated TIR and cross-border bonded trucking LLC. GAFI, the Egyptian Customs Authority and the Ministry of Transport require a physical, accessible Egyptian registered office and operational premises where corporate records, transport files and customs bond documentation are kept. A virtual or mailbox-only office cannot serve as the statutory head office or TIR authorized operator address.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 75% quantified annual likelihood for a newly incorporated TIR/customs bonded trucking LLC of at least one unannounced physical inspection by GAFI, the Commercial Registry, Ministry of Transport or Customs Authority during the first year of operations; inspection risk rises if an Authorized Economic Operator or TIR customs guarantee application is filed under Egyptian customs rules.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Law No. 159 of 1981, Articles 501-537 (Limited Liability Companies), as amended by Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 and its Executive Regulations (Prime Ministerial Decree No. 2310 of 2017); Commercial Registry Law No. 34 of 1976
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) - Central Companies Registry, One-Stop Shop, Cairo
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Notarized Memorandum of Association and the GAFI Electronic Incorporation Application Form
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for LLCs under Law 159/1981; capital is freely determined in the Memorandum of Association but must be fully subscribed at formation. In-kind contributions require certification by a registered accountant; no mandatory escrow deposit applies to cash contributions, provided at least 50% of the cash capital is paid before registration and the balance is settled within five years.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF EG_LLC, adopted by the founders at the statutory organization meeting. RESOLVED: (1) The Memorandum of Association and Articles as notarized are ratified; the issued share capital is unconditionally subscribed by the founding members and allotted as provided therein; (2) The registered office of the Company is fixed at Cairo, Arab Republic of Egypt, with the exact administrative address as filed in the Commercial Registry; (3) The following officers are appointed: Chairman/Managing Partner, CFO, and Compliance Manager; each is authorized to open bank accounts, execute leases, hire staff, and sign all incorporation filings; (4) The General Manager is authorized to procure the road-freight and TIR licenses identified by the Environmental and Transport authorities. Adoption carried unanimously.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Reservation and GAFI E-Service Account Setup
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop Shop (official electronic investment portal, www.gafi.gov.eg)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register an account on the GAFI online window, submit three proposed company names for clearance, obtain the name reservation certificate, and open the electronic incorporation file.
required_dossiers: Passport or National ID of each founding member
Three proposed company names
Draft Memorandum of Association in Arabic
Basic data of the founding members and intended managers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: File a written administrative objection with the GAFI Name Clearance Committee and simultaneously resubmit using the second acceptable proposed name within seven business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Authentication and Notarization of the Memorandum of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cairo Circuit Public Notary Office, Ministry of Justice
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the Memorandum of Association and internal articles before the notary in Arabic, verify identity of all founders or their lawful attorneys, pay the fixed stamp duties on the declared capital, and obtain the notarial authentication number required for GAFI submission.
required_dossiers: Final draft Memorandum of Association
Valid national ID or passport of each incorporator
Notarized power of attorney where a representative signs
Attendance certificate and stamp duty payment slips
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary issues a rejection for formal defects, the document must be corrected by a licensed Arabic legal drafter and re-attended with all signatories; non-Arabic speakers must appear with a certified legal translator.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Electronic Incorporation Filing with GAFI and Issue of Incorporation Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI Central Companies Registry, One-Stop Shop
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upload the notarized Memorandum of Association, name reservation certificate, and payment receipts to the GAFI electronic platform, obtain the provisional incorporation reference, pay the registration and publication fees, and receive the final Electronic Incorporation Certificate together with the automatic tax registration workflow reference.
required_dossiers: Notarized Memorandum of Association
Company name reservation certificate
Power of attorney of the local authorized agent where applicable
Proof of share capital subscription and payment receipts
GAFI electronic application form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, cure the stated notarial or documentary defect and file a supplementary memorandum; a formal rejection may be appealed before the GAFI Investment Grievance Committee within fifteen days from notification.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registry Entry and Issuance of Commercial Extract
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: General Department of Commercial Registration, Ministry of Interior
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the GAFI incorporation certificate to the Commercial Registry office, complete the registration form, enter the authorized signatory details, settle the registry dues, and obtain the certified commercial extract evidencing the legal existence and signatory powers of the LLC.
required_dossiers: GAFI incorporation certificate
Certified copy of the notarized Memorandum of Association
National ID or passport copies of the authorized signatories
Proof of registered address (lease contract or title deed)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry raises an address or signatory discrepancy, submit a municipal occupancy attestation or a corrected signatory resolution and re-file within ten business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration and Tax Card Application
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), Ministry of Finance
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply through the ETA electronic services platform for a Tax Identification Number (TIN), submit the request for a tax card, and complete simultaneous registrations for corporate income tax, value-added tax, stamp tax, and payroll withholding provisions.
required_dossiers: Commercial registry extract
GAFI incorporation certificate
Registered office lease and proof of occupancy
Board resolution naming the officers
Tax card application form and schedule of authorized accountants
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the ETA raises a data mismatch, the applicant must correct the affected field at the ETA settlement office, obtain a written discrepancy note, and resubmit the full file with a cover letter from a licensed tax advisor.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration with the Chamber of Commerce
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cairo Chamber of Commerce / Federation of Egyptian Chambers
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the commercial registry extract, tax card, and memorandum with the Cairo Chamber of Commerce, pay the annual membership fee, and obtain the membership certificate required as a precondition for customs authorizations and the subsequent TIR operator accreditation.
required_dossiers: Commercial registry extract
Tax card and TIN certificate
Certified copy of the Memorandum of Association
Board resolution confirming the responsible licensing officer
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If membership is withheld for unpaid prior assessment or documentation gaps, settle the chamber dues, submit the correction, and rely on the chamber's written confirmation if a delayed certificate impedes the transport license application.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Transport - General Authority for Land Transport, in coordination with the Egyptian Customs Authority for TIR Carnet accreditation
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Road Freight Haulage Operator License and Authorized TIR Carnet Operator Permit (issued under Road Transport Law No. 63 of 1992, as amended by Law No. 124 of 2021)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA), Ministry of Environment
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B - Environmental Registration Tier, requiring submission of Form B and a site environmental audit for truck terminals, parking yards and maintenance workshops; a full EIA Report may be escalated to a higher tier if fuel storage or wastewater volumes exceed prescribed thresholds.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Fleet exhaust must comply with Egyptian ambient emission limits per EEAA technical guidelines (EURO III/IV-compliant PM, CO and NOx thresholds); vehicle washing and maintenance wastewater must be treated to Law No. 48 of 1982 standards before discharge; used oils, batteries and hazardous maintenance waste shall be managed under Waste Management Law No. 202 of 2020; VOC emission limits for any paint and repair works follow EEAA Decree No. 293 of 2014.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the General Directorate of Civil Defense (Ministry of Interior) after on-site inspection; structural load and occupancy verification for vehicle sheds, offices and TIR parking yards issued by the competent engineering administration; and an occupational safety and health clearance from the Ministry of Manpower under Labor Law No. 12 of 2003 prior to commencement of operations.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) – Ministry of Finance; e-services portal at https://eservices.eta.gov.eg and e-invoicing clearance portal at https://invoicing.eta.gov.eg
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Upon incorporation of the Egyptian LLC under the Companies Law (Law 179/2020), file tax registration Form 1 with the local ETA tax office within 30 days to obtain a Tax Card (Bitaqa Dharibya). Register for VAT using Form 801/802 if annual taxable turnover reaches EGP 500,000 or voluntarily at EGP 150,000. For a foreign enterprise without a local entity, appoint a tax representative and obtain a VAT registration number for importer of record activities; all registrations are completed via the ETA e-services portal and generate a unified Tax Identification Number (TIN).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box or hybrid mismatch elections are available under Egyptian law. Applicable elections include: (i) fiscal unity (tax group) under Article 61 of Income Tax Law 91/2005 for companies with ≥95% shareholding; (ii) simplified final taxation for small businesses under Law 152/2020; (iii) voluntary VAT registration when below the threshold; and (iv) Free Zone incentives under Law 83/2002 (elected, not automatic).

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) – Law No. 67 of 2016, as amended by Law 28 of 2020 and Law 161 of 2022; administered by the Egyptian Tax Authority.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 500,000 annual taxable turnover (mandatory); voluntary registration from EGP 150,000. Registration is also required for any foreign supplier with an economic nexus in Egypt regardless of threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory e-invoicing for VAT-registered suppliers through the Farid system; invoices must be cleared by the ETA digital stamping engine in JSON/XML format via API or portal (invoicing.eta.gov.eg). Each invoice receives a unique serial number (UUID) and QR code; e-receipts are separately mandated for B2C transactions. No unsigned paper invoices may be issued by an integrated taxpayer.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rate VAT applies to cross-border overland trucking services that move goods into, out of, or through Egypt under TIR Carnets, when supplied to a non-resident carrier/principal, and supported by documented evidence that the transport begins or terminates outside Egypt; ancillary services physically rendered within Egypt but directly connected to exported goods are also zero-rated. The taxpayer must hold the TIR Carnet and export declarations issued by Egyptian Customs (Bayan Sahb).
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: TIR Carnet (official international customs transit document with guarantee chain)
Customs Export Declaration (Bayan Sahb / ACP statement)
CMR Waybill (Convention on the Contract for the International Carriage of Goods by Road)
Bill of Lading or Transit Transport Document (where applicable)
Inward Remittance Certificate (bank statement evidencing foreign currency receipt from the freight service)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export zero-rating is subject to stringent documentary audit by the ETA. If documentation is missing or false, the claimed 0% rate is reversed and the full 14% VAT is assessed, plus late-payment interest, an additional 30% penalty for misstatement, and criminal fines up to EGP 1,000,000 and/or imprisonment for tax evasion under Law 67/2016. Retrospective clawbacks cover six years of assessments, and repeat offenders may be removed from the TIR/zero-rating registers.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE; البنك المركزي المصري), operating under the Central Bank and Banking System Law No. 194 of 2020 and the CBE's binding instructions on banks and foreign-exchange operations; exclusive regulator of the unified interbank foreign-exchange market, payment systems, and bank licensing; coordinates with GAFI (General Authority for Investment and Free Zones) for inward capital registration and with the Ministry of Finance for tax-clearance-linked remittance controls.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Egyptian Pound (EGP) operates under a unified, market-determined flexible exchange-rate regime adopted in March 2024 through the IMF Extended Fund Facility framework; current-account items (freight revenues, TIR transit earnings, fuel, tolls, insurance, driver advances) are freely convertible through the banking channel against underlying transport contracts, CMR waybills, and TIR Carnets; capital-account transactions (equity subscriptions, shareholder loans with tenor over 12 months, intercompany debt, acquisition of Egyptian assets) are transferable only after bank-level commercial-purpose review and, where applicable, CBE no-objection or GAFI registration; dividend and profit remittance is treated as a permitted transfer but requires audited financial statements, the LLC's commercial register extract, an ETA tax-clearance certificate, and a board resolution evidencing the declared distribution; conversion of foreign currency to EGP must occur at the onshore interbank rate, and any attempt to use a parallel or divergent rate for onshore settlement is unlawful.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Egypt requires 100% repatriation of export and service proceeds, including cross-border trucking and TIR carriage receipts: the gross invoice amount must be credited to a bank account in Egypt within 180 days from the date of the transport invoice or completion of the transit operation, and any foreign currency received into an offshore account must be transmitted to the Egyptian settlement account within five working days from the date of offshore crediting; there is no mandatory conversion ratio to EGP in the current flexible-rate environment, so the LLC may elect to retain the entire balance as a foreign-currency deposit; the supporting file — TIR Carnet, CMR waybill, collection order, and bank credit advice — must be retained by the processing bank for CBE periodic verification; non-repatriation may give rise to administrative sanctions, the restriction of import-financing and foreign-currency facilities, and the suspension of future dividend-remittance approvals.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Rating: Low as a primary onshore settlement rail; permitted only as an ancillary offshore payment vehicle. An offshore digital EMI (for example, a UK-FCA or EU-EMD licensed e-money institution) cannot hold EGP on behalf of the Egyptian LLC, cannot provide a domestic Egyptian IBAN, and is not admitted to the CBE MIZAN/RTGS clearing architecture. Its permissible use is limited to hard-currency card programmes and e-wallet payments for fuel, tolls, border fees, and driver advances on foreign corridors, provided the entire net treasury position is swept on a daily or contractual basis back to a fully compliant Egyptian bank account and all such flows are reflected in the Egyptian commercial books; any agreement with the EMI must be registered in the transfer-pricing documentation file of the LLC.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Mandatory in-person KYC interview: at least two authorised signatories as designated by the LLC board resolution and one natural-person Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) must appear physically at the chosen bank branch for the compliance interview; original passport or national ID, specimen signature cards, and the bank's corporate KYC questionnaire must be completed on site. Remote account opening is not available for corporate capital or operational accounts of a locally incorporated Egyptian LLC; digital identification may only complement the face-to-face file. TIR drivers and route managers nominated as cardholders are onboarded through the company's corporate card registry without requiring individual bank interviews, but their identity documents must be retained in the merchant and card compliance file.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO chain opacity: foreign shareholders or GCC/EU family trusts holding indirect interests through a non-Egyptian holding company, particularly nominee arrangements concealing natural-person ownership equal to or exceeding 25%.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of incorporation and MOA/AOA of EG_LLC; notarised Arabic translation where required; full share register of the LLC; UBO declaration identifying every natural person with 25% or greater ownership; chain-of-title charts for each intermediate holding entity; passport copies of all natural-person UBOs; commercial register extract (السجل التجاري); tax card (بطاقة ضريبية); and a notarised board resolution appointing signatories and ratifying the account mandate.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions and geographic-risk flags on long-haul trucking corridors: vehicles, drivers, or counterparties connected to Libya, Sudan, Syria, Iran, or Egyptian red-listed border areas; TIR Carnet guarantee chain raising transit-security concerns.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Route manifest with GPS coordinates; TIR Carnet issued by the Egyptian national guaranteeing association; CMR waybills for each leg; commercial contracts with consignors and consignees stating standard freight terms; driver identity and licence deck; sanctions-screening certificate confirming no OFAC/UN/EU/UK-listed parties; and a written assurance of customs bond adequacy during transit.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unusual lump-sum fund movements or third-party funding of fleet acquisition through shared fuel-card and payment pools, particularly where the parent's stated revenue is unrelated to haulage services.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited financial statements of the shareholder or parent; executed capital contribution or shareholder-loan agreement; GAFI investment certificate or registration; FATCA/CRS self-certification of each counterparty; cash-flow projection linking fuel-card top-ups to cargo volumes and mileage records; and audited bank statements demonstrating no gold-trading, cryptocurrency, or unexplained cash intermediation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-based money-laundering mismatch: freight invoice valuations that diverge materially from cargo described on the CMR or TIR Carnet, or repeated early termination of transit guarantees without commercial explanation.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed TIR guarantee file from the Egyptian issuing association; CMR waybills reconciled to customs entry and exit stamps; border-crossing receipts; tariff schedule showing arm's-length haulage rates; transfer-pricing memorandum supporting the freight fees; and freight-commission agreements with any freight forwarders or agents on the corridor.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All equity and shareholder-advance injections are routed via SWIFT MT103 (or MT202 for nostro-to-nostro repositioning) to the EG_LLC capital escrow account held with the authorised Egyptian bank; the wire should carry a BPM6-compatible purpose narrative — 'Direct Investment, Equity Inward' for paid-in capital and 'Intercompany Lending' for advances — together with a reference to the GAFI registration number, the LLC's commercial register number, and the underlying board resolution or shareholder-loan agreement. The receiving bank requires: corporate account-opening mandate; capital subscription board resolution; notarised LLC formation since non-resident ownership is permitted; GAFI compliance certificate under Investment Law No. 72 of 2017; and a signed balance-of-payments return for CBE statistical reporting. Share-capital funds must remain in the capital escrow account until the amended memorandum of association is attested by the competent notary; shareholder loans with maturity exceeding 12 months are classified as capital-account obligations and their offshore interest remittance requires CBE no-objection.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Operational disbursements for cross-border trucking (fuel-card clearing, lubricants, spare parts, tolls, border fees, driver transit advances, and TIR Carnet charges) are executed through the onshore operational account using local EGP direct debits, card-linked fuel-clearing through the Egyptian payment network, and SWIFT MT103 transfers to foreign beneficiaries supported by the underlying proforma invoice, CMR, and TIR Carnet. Fleet and container purchases are settled via irrevocable commercial letters of credit (SWIFT MT700) or documentary collections; the CBE's February 2022 instruction that imports be made exclusively by documentary credit has been rescinded by the March 2023 instruction, so direct outward transfers are permitted subject to presentation of the customs import declaration and tax-compliance evidence. A standing pre-registered payment file for recurring corridor disbursements (Suez Canal Economic Zone, Red Sea ports, Mediterranean and North African land borders) should be maintained with the settlement bank to accelerate clearing without duplicating KYC or documentary review.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable outright foreign-exchange forwards (plain vanilla, tenor up to 12 months) with CBE-licensed Egyptian banks, supported by genuine underlying trade or transport invoices and recorded in the bank's derivative risk ledger.
FX swaps executed bilaterally with the settlement bank to convert EGP into USD or EUR for fuel, tolls, driver cash pooling, and back-conversion of surplus hard-currency corridor revenues.
Cross-currency interest-rate swaps (CCIRS) for long-horizon USD or EUR fleet-finance liabilities against EGP operational revenues, subject to prior CBE no-objection and bank credit approval.

Foreign-currency deposit sweeps combined with collateralised deliverable forwards; onshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are not offered by authorised Egyptian banks and the LLF should avoid unlicensed offshore NDF dealing which would breach CBE convertibility supervision.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Company File Confirmation (Data Update) with General Authority for Investment (GAFI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment (GAFI), Ministry of Investment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months of the fiscal year end; annual calendar anniversary of certificate issuance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late fee per GAFI schedule; suspension of commercial registration and eligibility for state incentives; further delay triggers administrative strike-off

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Commercial Registry Renewal / Annual Declaration of Updated Particulars
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commercial Registry under the Ministry of Trade and Industry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by the commercial registration anniversary date; renewals must be submitted before the end of the registration month
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Progressive late penalty, potential removal of commercial register record, inability to enter into enforceable contracts with banks or customs

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate Income Tax Return (Form 19) and Audited Financial Statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months of the fiscal year end (tax period), unless a valid extension is granted
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Interest at 2% per month on tax due; additional severe penalties; stop notice on clearing through customs for cross-border operations under TIR carnets

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Audited Annual Financial Statements Filing to GAFI
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months of the fiscal year end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine; loss of good standing certificate; risk of forced rectification or strike-off after prolonged noncompliance

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) Annual Confirmation Declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment (GAFI) UBO Registry / Financial Regulatory Authority overlapping regime
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually with the company file update; within 30 days of any ownership or beneficiary change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines under article governing UBO registers; suspension of company file; potential criminal liability for non-compliant directors

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Economic Activity License and Operating Permit Maintenance (TIR/Cross-Border Haulage)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Transport – Land Transport Regulatory Authority and Customs Authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual renewal before license expiry date; vehicle fleet TIR carnets renewed per calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Suspension of cargo operations and customs bonded status; fines for operation without current license; temporary seizure under customs law

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: All LLCs in Egypt are required to appoint a licensed external auditor on a continuous basis; no statutory size or turnover exemption applies under Companies Law 159 of 1981 and Investment Law 72 of 2017. The audit must cover annual financial statements presented in accordance with Egyptian Accounting Standards.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS) as issued by the Ministry of Finance and the Egyptian Society of Accountants and Auditors; IFRS is required for listed companies and banks, but for LLCs EAS is mandatory.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The LLC must maintain its UBO register at the registered office and file any shareholding transfer or UBO change with GAFI within 30 days. Annually, the company must submit a confirmation declaration of unchanged beneficial ownership together with the company file update. Any failure to keep the UBO register current invalidates the annual good standing certificate.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 200-600 annually for registered office address and correspondence agency in Cairo or Alexandria
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 800-2,500 annually for a licensed Egyptian audit firm, based on scope of cross-border revenue and fleet size

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No blanket tax holiday for onshore trucking. Investment Law No. 72/2017 grants a deduction of up to 50% of investment cost from taxable profits for qualifying projects in Governorate A (less-developed) areas and Suez Canal Economic Zone projects; licensed free-zone logistics projects may elect exemption from CIT in exchange for an annual 1%-2% of revenues fee. Export-oriented income derived from bonded TIR cross-border carriage may qualify for the standard rate only unless a specific incentive approval is obtained.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form No. 113 - Corporate Income Tax Return (Income Tax Law No. 91/2005), filed electronically through the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) unified e-filing portal at https://www.eta.gov.eg (El-Moda/ETA e-Tax system).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual return, supplemented by four quarterly advance payment installments during the tax year.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Form 113 must be submitted and the balance of tax paid within 4 months after the end of the approved tax year; for a standard Egyptian fiscal year (1 July - 30 June), the deadline is 31 October; for ETA-approved calendar-year filers, 30 April.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name, unified tax registration number, tax card number, commercial registry number, address, legal form (Limited Liability Company), ISIC 5221 activity code, and tax year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A for the resident EG LLC; non-resident shareholders or foreign head-office attributes are not recorded in this box.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Accrual basis per Egyptian Accounting Standards; declaration of the approved fiscal year; currency of account (EGP).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A; non-resident operators deriving Egypt-source income must instead prepare separate branch accounts.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross freight income from cross-border TIR trucking, including Egypt-leg hauls and the Egypt-source portion of transit routes; segregation of domestic, bonded, and international carriage revenue.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A; the resident LLC declares worldwide income, with foreign-source income segregated to claim treaty/unilateral foreign tax credits.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Fuel card clearing costs, tolls, TIR Carnet issuance fees, driver wages, cargo insurance, spare parts, and wheels; supported by fuel-card statements and bank wire evidence.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A; deductions must be invoiced to the Egyptian taxpayer and paid out of Egyptian bank accounts.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 5 - Other Operating Expenses and Depreciation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Fleet depreciation (tractors/trailers), lease rentals, IT, communications, customs agency fees, depreciation per ETA schedule, and amortization of intangible assets.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A; all depreciation must relate to assets placed in the Egyptian fleet and used in the taxable activity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Provision for doubtful debts without legal action, entertainment above the statutory cap, fines, penalties, excess related-party interest (thin cap), CIT itself, and expenses settled in cash above EGP 100,000 per invoice without bank card evidence.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A; payments to non-resident related parties must be reflected with arm's-length balance confirmation to avoid add-back.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Investment Law 72/2017 cost deduction (up to 50% of investment cost in qualifying areas/SCZone), pre-existing tax holidays, and treaty-exempt categories of foreign income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A; treaty benefits on inbound payments are claimed by the foreign payee through WHT relief, not in this box.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computation of prior-year tax losses offset against current-year taxable profit; losses older than 5 years are expired; loss-year tax audit must have been opened with the ETA.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A; foreign shareholders cannot utilise Egyptian tax losses outside the Egyptian taxpayer.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 9 - Taxable Base and Rate Computation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable profit before tax, application of the 22.5% headline rate, withholding tax credits, and quarterly advance prepayments are credited here.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A; dividend WHT at 10% is a final tax, not an instalment of the LLC's CIT.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Audited financial statements, related-party transaction schedule, Transfer Pricing Disclosure Form (if related-party transactions exceed EGP 10,000,000), bank confirmation of wire/fuel-card flows, TIR carnet register summary, and tax compliance certificate from the customs authority.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A; a non-resident party to Egyptian controlled transactions must respond to ETA TP information orders and obtain a TRC for treaty relief.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers a statutory delay surcharge of 2% per month (or fraction) on the unpaid tax, plus fixed administrative fines (approx. EGP 5,000-10,000) and the loss of installment/credit benefits; failure to pay the assessed balance by the filing deadline attracts the same 2% monthly surcharge and enforced bank attachment; a materially incorrect return is treated as non-filing and transferred to the fraud unit.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% final withholding tax on dividends and profit distributions made by the Egyptian LLC to non-resident shareholders (Article 56, Law 91/2005); distributions to resident Egyptian corporate shareholders are exempt under the dividend-received exemption, while distributions to resident individuals are subject to the 10% final WHT.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To apply the reduced DTA rate: (i) the foreign shareholder obtains a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from its own tax authority, legalized/stamped as applicable and translated into Arabic; (ii) the Egyptian LLC submits an application to the ETA Foreign Tax Department attaching the TRC, ownership certificate, and a beneficial-ownership declaration before the distribution date; (iii) the ETA issues a reduced-withholding or no-withholding approval letter to the paying entity; (iv) if tax was over-withheld, initiate a refund application to the ETA within the statutory limitation period (5 years); all application documents must be retained for inspection.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties (IP, trademarks, software): statutory 20% WHT under Article 57; DTA rates commonly 10%-15%. Debt interest: statutory 20% WHT; DTA rates commonly 10%-15%; no WHT on interest paid to banks under specific treaty provisions. International carriage profits: Egypt's DTAs generally allocate profits from international road transport to the residence state, resulting in 0% Egyptian WHT for qualifying TIR hauliers; treaty-specific verification is required.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File mandatory when annual related-party transactions exceed EGP 10,000,000; Master File mandatory when annual related-party transactions exceed EGP 20,000,000 or the MNE group exceeds the ETA-prescribed group revenue threshold; CbC Report required for Egyptian ultimate parent entities of MNE groups with consolidated revenue exceeding EGP 12,000,000,000.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Egypt imposes no UAE-style Economic Substance Regulations; however, the ETA applies anti-abuse and substance doctrines: (i) GAAR under Articles 121-131 of Law 91/2005 allowing re-characterization of arrangements lacking commercial substance; (ii) CFC rules attributing undistributed profits of low-tax foreign companies to Egyptian shareholders; (iii) thin-capitalization and interest-deduction limits on related-party debt; (iv) treaty-abuse prevention via the principal-purpose test under the OECD Multilateral Instrument (Egypt is a signatory); (v) practical substance indicators (real premises, operating staff, own/leased fleet, warehouse control, and business bank accounts) must support the cross-border TIR transport activity to defend deductions and treaty access.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate under-declaration of freight revenue, off-book cash fuel payments, fake or inflated invoices for international TIR hauls, or recall of EGP-denominated financial statements contrary to the approved accounting basis.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Collection of evaded tax plus 2% monthly delay surcharge; criminal sanctions under Law 91/2005 including imprisonment (up to 5 years) and fines (EGP 20,000-100,000); publication of the judgment at the offender's expense; the ETA also may seize bank accounts and suspend the unified tax card.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and legal representatives who sign false returns are jointly and severally liable to pay the evaded tax, penalties, and surcharges; conviction triggers imprisonment, automatic travel ban, and asset freezing.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Late or Non-Filing of CIT Return
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to file Form 113 within 4 months after fiscal year-end, or failure to pay quarterly advance installments on their statutory due dates.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: 2% per-month delay surcharge on the outstanding balance; administrative fines per ETA penalty schedule; loss of the right to offset prepayments; the ETA may issue an assessment by estimation based on bank turnover and enforce via garnishment of transportation receivables.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The signatory director remains personally liable for taxes withheld at source from salaries and subcontractor fees and is exposed to criminal exposure where non-filing was intentional.
